{{Article header
 |eyebrow=EDFM // Ships
 |deck=Directory of Commander-piloted starships, organized by landing-pad size with basic hull information and links to each ship.
}}

'''Ships''' are the primary vessels flown by Commanders in [[Elite Dangerous]]. They range from small fighters and utility craft to large freighters, passenger liners, exploration vessels, and warships.

There are currently '''48 independently operated starships''' in Live. Ships introduced after the Live and Legacy branches separated are marked '''Live only'''.<ref name="inara-ships">[https://inara.cz/elite/ships/ Ships], Inara.</ref><ref name="frontier-starships">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/equipment/starships Starships], Frontier Developments.</ref>

{{Field note|This directory covers ships that operate as a Commander's primary starship. [[Ship-Launched Craft]], including fighters and the [[Nomad]], [[Surface Recon Vehicles|SRVs]], [[Fleet Carriers]], megaships, and capital ships are separate vessel classes and are not included in the tables below.<ref name="frontier-nomad">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/nomad-available-now-arx-early-access Nomad — Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments.</ref>}}

== Reading the directory ==

Ships are grouped by the landing-pad size they require.

; Small
: Uses a small landing pad. Small ships can also use medium and large pads when available.

; Medium
: Requires at least a medium landing pad.

; Large
: Requires a large landing pad. Large ships cannot dock at standard orbital outposts because those stations do not provide large landing pads.

The '''base hull price''' is the standard price of the stock ship itself. It does not include upgraded modules, Engineering, stored equipment, or rebuy costs, and actual purchase prices can be lower where shipyard discounts apply.

'''Live & Legacy''' means the ship exists in both current Live and Legacy versions. '''Live only''' identifies ships introduced after development of the two versions diverged.

{{Important|Some ships have additional purchase requirements, including [[Federal Navy]] or [[Imperial Navy]] rank, special account entitlements, or current-version ownership conditions. Those requirements are documented on the individual ship page rather than repeated throughout this directory.}}

{{Field note|A higher hull price does not automatically make a ship better for a particular activity. Ship size, internal compartments, hardpoints, handling, jump capability, module compatibility, and intended build can matter far more than purchase price.}}

== Other vessels ==

Not every pilotable or player-owned vessel is a primary starship.

* '''[[Ship-Launched Fighters]]''' — short-range combat craft deployed from compatible ships.
* '''[[Nomad]]''' — ship-launched utility vessel deployed through a compatible Mk II Vessel Bay.
* '''[[Surface Recon Vehicles]]''' — planetary surface vehicles carried aboard ships.
* '''[[Fleet Carriers]]''' — player-owned capital-scale mobile bases rather than conventionally piloted ships.

These vessel types are documented separately because their acquisition, deployment, outfitting, and operation differ substantially from normal starships.
